in_sanskrit.name: धर्मपाल
in_sanskrit.meaning: धर्म: righteousness, virtue, law; पाल: protector, ruler
in_sanskrit.long_meaning: One who protects and upholds righteousness and virtue, a lawful ruler.

in_hindi.name: धर्मपाल
in_hindi.meaning: धर्म: दिक्कीर्ति (dikkir-ti): virtue, righteousness, morality, honor; पाल: पालन (pa-lan): protection, governance, management, care
in_hindi.long_meaning: One who protects, governs, manages, and cares for righteousness, virtue, morality, honor.

in_tamil.name: தர்மபால்
in_tamil.meaning: தர்மம்: நன்மை (nan-mai): virtue, righteousness, morality; பால்: அமர்ச்சனம் (amar-c-cana-m): protection, governance, rule
in_tamil.long_meaning: One who protects, governs, and rules with virtue, righteousness, and morality.

in_telugu.name: ధర్మపాల
in_telugu.meaning: ధర్మ: దేశము (de-shamu): virtue, morality, righteousness; పాల: పేజేజేశ్య (p-e-je-je-shy): protection, governance, management, care
in_telugu.long_meaning: One who protects, governs, manages, and cares for virtue, morality, and righteousness.

in_marathi.name: Dharmpal
in_marathi.long_meaning: Dharmpal हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। The name Dharmpal is derived from Sanskrit words 'Dharma' and 'Pal'. Dharma represents righteousness, morality, and duty, while Pal means protector. Therefore, Dharmpal is a name for someone who upholds righteousness and protects it.
